teaching.en: Garden Code is the best choice for this reading club. It is a 220-page mystery about a gardener decoding letters, so its genre, plot and length fit the group. I recommend Garden Code because it satisfies every essential preference. The club should still warn members that the beginning develops slowly.

It is suitable for ages ten and over and has no frightening content. However, its ending is predictable. Moon Door lasts only 88 minutes, but scary scenes and a twelve-plus rating break two limits. Long Weekend has the right genre and age rating, although 126 minutes exceeds the maximum. Busy Neighbours therefore offers the best fit, and families should only be warned that the final events are easy to predict.
